facts.fact: The Data Protection Office issued guidance notes in response to queries on implementing the Data Protection (Designation, Tasks and Position of Data Protection Officers) Regulations 2026, and runs the e-DPO Portal and the DPO certification programme.
The Data Protection Office is acting as the body under the Data Protection Act, issuing guidance notes and running a DPO certification programme and the e-DPO Portal.

The Data Protection Office published guidance notes on the designation and certification of data protection officers, and says certification training and a registration communique will follow before the DPO Regulations 2026 come into force on 1 January 2027.

facts.fact: The Data Protection Office is acting as the supervisory body, answering controllers' queries and issuing guidance notes on the DPO Regulations 2026.
The Data Protection Office issued guidance on DPO designation and certification and requires controllers to update their designated DPO details through its e-DPO Portal.
